turns.prompt_text: there's a blizzard and there's a guy stuck in a ditch what should I do
turns.response_html:
Immediate Safety First

  • Call 911 or local emergency services immediately to report the location and condition of the driver.
  • Stay in your vehicle if you are also on the road; visibility is low, and you risk being hit by other drivers or succumbing to the cold.
  • Communicate from a distance by flashing your lights or honking to let them know help is coming, but do not attempt a manual rescue unless you have proper recovery gear and can do so without getting stuck yourself.

If You Must Approach

ActionReason
Check TailpipeEnsure it isn't clogged with snow to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning if their engine is running.
Keep MovingIf you are outside, move your arms and legs to maintain body heat.
Stay VisibleUse road flares or hazard lights to alert snowplows and emergency responders.
